name: Evolutionary Health and Medicine Minor
intro: The minor in Evolutionary Health and Medicine offers a rigorous exploration of human health through an evolutionary lens. It critically examines the historical constraints and evolutionary compromises inherent in the human body, utilizing these insights to elucidate vulnerabilities to disease.
